question_summary: Submitter requests approval to substitute a linear slot diffuser in lieu of the specified perforated face diffuser under Section 23 82 00.
proposed_solution: Substitute a linear slot alternate diffuser in lieu of the specified perforated face diffuser.
deadline_text: A response within three business days would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: The substitution involves an HVAC diffuser specified under Section 23 82 00, which falls under the Mechanical Engineer's review authority.
